_comment: Golden fixture for sleeves.rules.schema rule-class derivation (AC-20). This is a specification TABLE the test-writer is defining (analogous to envelope.py's REASON_* code table) -- not a producer-computed value being hardcoded. Each case lists a `then` action-type list and the class that MUST be derived from it structurally.
_action_vocabulary: buy (position-opening), sell/go_to_cash/set_stop/notify (reduce-only / non-opening). go_to_cash is the SLEEVE's own liquidate-to-cash action (matches the `action` column example in migrations/034_sleeve_rule_fires.sql) -- distinct from the plan's separate 'existing Composer go-to-cash for symphonies' concept, which is out of actions.py's P2 scope.
_class_rule: DEFENSIVE = every action is reduce-only (sell/go_to_cash/set_stop/notify -- no position-opening action). ENTRY = the action set contains at least one position-opening action (buy). A rule whose action set mixes buy with any other action is INVALID (expected_class: null) -- AC-20 forbids a rule claiming DEFENSIVE while holding entry actions, and a rule cannot be simultaneously both classes.
